checks.name: ⌥⌘J goes to the next agent that needs you; ⌥⌘Y allows and ⌥⌘⌫ denies its request
⌥⌘J goes on to the agents to review (the failure, then the finished run with changes); visiting clears each
⌥⌘A switches agents from a searchable quick pick and ⌥⌘. stops the selected agent
⌥⌘N starts a new agent from the composer without the mouse; it becomes the selected agent
Enter in the chat composer sends a follow-up
the shortcuts also work from the side bar (⌥⌘A opens the agent switcher, ⌥⌘N the composer)
